purpose: Interpret one schema-valid instantaneous Weight projection, schema version 1, into the type-specific body of a Canonical Revision through the interpret-source-projection@1 processor interface: the source mass as a float in its canonical gram unit, exactly as projected, checked against the pinned Health Connect SDK's bounds, without smoothing, latest-value selection, tie-breaking, derived measures, or unit conversion.

inputs.name: weight_record
inputs.description: The decoded record object of one Weight projection, schema version 1, as interpret-source-projection@1 passes it after closed-schema validation, the year-range check, and time attribution: the instant with its optional offset, and the mass in grams, which arrives as a Python int when its canonical JSON number has no fraction.

inputs.name: temporal_header
inputs.description: The instant temporal header interpret-source-projection@1 built for the projection, with its exact instant, applied offset, local date, and attribution.

inputs.name: sdk_bounds
inputs.description: The mass bounds that the pinned Health Connect SDK 1.1.0 WeightRecord constructor enforces, recorded in this unit's pack.

outputs.name: weight_body
outputs.description: The Weight body, version 1: the source mass as a finite float in the canonical unit g, numerically equal to the projected value, with no average, trend, BMI, latest-value judgment, or copy of the header.

outputs.name: quarantine_outcome
outputs.description: A Quarantine with this processor's declared health-data-free reason weight-out-of-range and the JSON pointer of the mass field, never a value.

owns: the Weight body, version 1, and its declared numeric field
the exact float representation of a mass whose canonical JSON number has no fraction
the Weight validity rule beyond the closed schema: the pinned SDK's mass bounds
the Weight quarantine reason and the source field it names
does_not_own: envelope decoding, schema validation, the revision header, time attribution, Policy-Pending, or canonical bytes, which interpret-source-projection@1 owns
persisting outcomes, Processing Jobs, or Processor Generations
latest-local-day selection, equal-time duplicate grouping, unresolved ties, point series, source selection, or summaries, which Phase 5 owns
